# 8th CPC Pension Calculator

> Free, bilingual (English + Hindi) calculators for Indian central government pensioners and family pensioners to estimate their pension under the 8th Central Pay Commission. All 8th CPC figures are estimates: the official fitment factor has not been announced.

Key facts (as of 28 October 2026):
- 8th Central Pay Commission constituted 3 November 2025; chair Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai; report expected around mid-2027.
- Official 8th CPC fitment factor: not yet announced. 7th CPC factor was 2.57. Common estimates range 1.92 to 2.86; unions demand 3.833.
- Dearness Relief (DR): 60% from 1 January 2026. July 2026 DR not yet officially announced.
- Formula: new basic pension = current basic pension x fitment factor (rounded up to the next rupee). Additional pension for age 80+ (20%), 85+ (30%), 90+ (40%), 95+ (50%), 100+ (100%).
- Family pension: 30% of last pay (normal), 50% enhanced for the first period.

## Calculators
- [8th Pay Commission pension calculator](https://8cpc-pension-calculator.vercel.app/): new pension, DR comparison and arrears
- [Hindi version / हिंदी](https://8cpc-pension-calculator.vercel.app/hi/)
- [Basic pension finder](https://8cpc-pension-calculator.vercel.app/basic-pension-finder/): basic pension from the monthly bank credit or PPO
- [Pre-2016 pensioners](https://8cpc-pension-calculator.vercel.app/pre-2016-pensioners/): higher of 2.57x and notional pay fixation
- [DA / DR calculator](https://8cpc-pension-calculator.vercel.app/da-dr-calculator/)
- [Fitment factor calculator](https://8cpc-pension-calculator.vercel.app/fitment-factor-calculator/)
- [Family pension calculator](https://8cpc-pension-calculator.vercel.app/family-pension-calculator/)
- [Defence pension calculator](https://8cpc-pension-calculator.vercel.app/defence-pension-calculator/)
- [8th CPC pension chart](https://8cpc-pension-calculator.vercel.app/pension-chart/)
